_comment: S4 verification inputs for the usbbuck4 golden (test fixture). /MCO is the clock-out net with the F.Cu->B.Cu transition at (141,123); USB_DP/DM are the FS pair (skew belongs to S5 check_diffpair, return path is checked here).

placement._comment: S9 placement inputs (edges match the hand-placed golden: USB left, SWD right, MCO header bottom). The xtal group locks the load caps to the crystal until S7 emits satellite metadata.

esd._comment: check_esd (#312): J2 (SWD) and J3 (MCO_OUT probe header) are bench-only, so they are not judged. /USB_DP and /USB_DM run from the micro-USB straight to the STM32F103 with no clamp, so the finding is real. They are exempt here because the golden is a never-built fixture whose verify run must stay clean, and tests/test_check_esd.py pins them as true findings. VBUS stays judged; its warning is a known one (10 uF + 4.7 uF at the connector, recorded fp in triage.yaml).
